LowerCourt: United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit

ProceedingsandOrder.Text: Application (25A1046) to extend the time to file a petition for a writ of certiorari from March 30, 2026 to April 29, 2026, submitted to The Chief Justice.

Pursuant to Rule 34.6 and Paragraph 9 of the Guidelines for the Submission of Documents to the Supreme Court's Electronic Filing System, filings in this case should be submitted in paper form only, and should not be submitted through the Court's electronic filing system.
Application (25A1046) granted by The Chief Justice extending the time to file until April 29, 2026.
Application (25A1046) to extend further the time from April 29, 2026 to May 29, 2026, submitted to The Chief Justice.
Application (25A1046) granted by The Chief Justice extending the time to file until May 29, 2026.
Petition for a writ of certiorari filed. (Response due July 2, 2026)
Motion to extend the time to file a response from July 2, 2026 to August 3, 2026, submitted to The Clerk.
Motion to extend the time to file a response is granted and the time is extended to and including August 3, 2026.
Brief of respondent Izuchukwu Ozurumba in opposition filed.
Reply of petitioner Todd Blanche, Attorney General filed.  (Distributed)
